note: SHA-256 of each lowercase name, words joined by one space (src/core/contracts/token-hash.ts, the helper tree-checks uses for its banned token). The first four are the workspace organization names (split on the slash) and the named examples of the anchoring rule; the last is a fictional name the tests plant, so no test file holds a real one. The names are never written in the tree; the rule matches the hash of 1 to max_words consecutive words.
